title: Masterclasses page
content:
Chemistry Exam Edge

Eight Sunday masterclasses to build confidence, skills and exam marks — one for National 5, Higher and Advanced Higher on the last Sunday of every month. Book a single masterclass when you need it, or secure all eight with the Masterclass Pass.

One Sunday a month, three levels

Each level has its own hour, its own focus and its own pass — so a masterclass is always pitched exactly where your child is.

National 5

8-Masterclass Pass — £119 · all eight Sundays for the price of six and a half

Higher

8-Masterclass Pass — £145 · all eight Sundays for the price of six and a half

Advanced Higher

8-Masterclass Pass — £169 · all eight Sundays for the price of six and a half

Every masterclass includes

The live session

An hour on Zoom with Lynsey — taught, not talked at, with questions answered in the room.

The recording

Sent out afterwards, so a missed Sunday is never a missed masterclass — and revision can rewatch it.

Downloadable resources

The materials from the session, yours to keep and use right up to the exam.

🎁 Book the full 8-Masterclass Pass and a free pack of revision flashcards is posted to your door.

Booking and payment are handled securely through the Molecular Miracles shop — card or PayPal, with everything delivered automatically.
